Thank you very much, Max, for your kind comments and for highlighting our hospitality and helpfulness 🌸. We are delighted that you enjoyed the comfort, cleanliness, and location of the apartment.

We were, however, a little surprised by the 7.5 rating for staff, as it seems somewhat inconsistent with your positive remarks. We always do our very best to be responsive and available to ensure our guests have a pleasant stay.

Your feedback is nevertheless very valuable to us, and it encourages us to keep improving. We would be very happy to welcome you back to Madeira in the future ✨🏝
Natalia & Hugo

text.title: It was a very nice stay.
text.good: Great location, nice and quiet, second row to the sea, sound of the sea included, bus stop right outside, everything easily and quickly accessible. Many thanks to the truly lovely hosts for making the departure to the airport, which you organized, go so smoothly! We felt very comfortable.

original.title: Es war sein sehr schöner Aufenthalt.
original.good: Super Lage, schön ruhig, 2. Reihe zum Meer, Meeresrauschen inklusive, Bus vor der Tür, alles gut und schnell erreichbar. Vielen Dank an die wirklich sehr netten Gastgeber, dass auch die von euch organisierte Abreise zum Flughafen so gut geklappt hat! Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.

reviews.name: Diana

text.title: Perfect stay
text.good: The apartment is amazing and very well-equipped; you truly have everything you need. The hosts were great as well, with very fast and easy communication. The terrace is beyond beautiful. The location is excellent—really close to the city center, yet you still have your own peaceful spot near the beach. There are plenty of markets and restaurants around, and if we ever come back to Madeira, we would definitely stay here again.

reviews.reply:
Thank you so much for your wonderful feedback. It truly makes us happy to hear that your stay was perfect and that you enjoyed the apartment, the terrace, and the neighborhood.
You were fantastic guests, and communicating with you was really easy.
If you ever come back to Madeira, we’d be delighted to welcome you again.
Natalia & Hugo

reviews.name: Carmelo

text.good: Posizione dell'appartamento ottima, ampi spazi. Vicinato stupendo, molto fornito di locali per cenare e pranzare ma anche supermercato. A due passi da Funchal e dal centro. Inoltre ottimo per l'utilizzo del box auto. Proprietari molto gentili e disponibili per qualsiasi evenienza.
text.bad: Sarebbe carino poter usufruire di un servizio di pulizia dell'appartamento minimo 1 volta ogni 7 giorni.

reviews.reply:
Ciao,

Grazie per il tuo feedback. Siamo felici che tu abbia apprezzato la posizione dell’appartamento, il quartiere e la vicinanza al centro di Funchal. È stato un piacere ospitarti.

Per quanto riguarda il servizio di pulizia durante il soggiorno, ci dispiace ci sia stato un malinteso. Se ce lo avessi richiesto, avremmo potuto organizzarlo senza problemi.

Il prezzo della prenotazione include infatti solo la pulizia finale dopo la partenza, oltre alla gestione della biancheria da letto e da bagno, per garantire un alto standard di pulizia a tutti gli ospiti.

Il servizio di pulizia durante il soggiorno non è incluso, ma può essere organizzato su richiesta anticipata.

Grazie ancora per il tuo soggiorno e per il tuo commento.

Cordiali saluti,
Natália & Hugo
